intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered for two. Watch the sun melt into the horizon while sipping champagne and enjoying a curated platter of local and international canapés. A quintessential romantic experience perfect for honeymooners seeking intimacy and breathtaking natural beauty.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore some of the Maldives' most vibrant coral gardens teeming with sea turtles, reef sharks, manta rays, and thousands of tropical fish. A guided snorkeling safari takes you to three pristine reef sites across the atoll, with a marine biologist on hand to narrate the underwater world. Snorkeling gear and a light tropical lunch on a sandbank are included.
experiences.location: Baa Atoll UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, Maldives

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in a couples' massage and spa ritual at one of the world's most iconic underwater spa facilities. Set beneath the ocean surface with panoramic glass walls revealing the reef ecosystem, this luxurious 90-minute treatment uses locally sourced coconut oil and tropical botanicals. An unparalleled honeymoon splurge that blends wellness with the magic of the sea.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Maldivian Cooking Class and Beachside Dinner
experiences.description: Learn the art of traditional Maldivian cuisine with a local chef on a secluded beach. Discover how to prepare dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish broth, and coconut-infused curries using fresh island ingredients. The class concludes with a romantic candlelit dinner for two on the beach under a canopy of stars, with the sound of gentle waves as your backdrop.
experiences.location: Maafushi Island, South Malé Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience
experiences.description: Witness one of nature's most magical phenomena as the ocean glows electric blue with bioluminescent plankton after dark. Guided by expert marine naturalists, wade into the warm shallows and snorkel through a living light show that feels otherworldly. This rare and deeply romantic experience is unique to certain Maldivian islands and creates memories that last a lifetime for honeymooning couples.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience
experiences.description: Witness one of nature's most magical phenomena as the ocean glows electric blue with bioluminescent plankton after dark. Guided by expert marine naturalists, wade into the warm shallows and snorkel through a living light show that feels otherworldly. This rare and deeply romantic experience is unique to certain Maldivian islands and creates memories that last a lifetime for honeymooning couples.

day_by_day.morning: N/A - Flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A - In transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30. Clear immigration and customs. Arrange speedboat or ferry transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, freshen up, and enjoy a welcome drink at the resort. Take a quiet stroll along the beachfront to soak in the night atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: On the flight
meals.lunch: On the flight or at the airport
meals.dinner: Light snack or room service upon arrival at the resort

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange your airport transfer with Aegean Bliss Resort before arrival to save time and money. Keep some USD or MVR handy for tips and small expenses. Night arrival means no activities — rest is the priority.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up to your first Maldivian sunrise from the beachfront. Explore the resort grounds and beach. Take a leisurely swim in the crystal-clear lagoon in front of the resort. Rent a snorkel set from the resort's water sports center (budget option) and do a self-guided snorkel session around the house reef.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the nearest local island by public ferry or resort shuttle for an authentic Maldivian experience. Explore the island village, visit a local café for fresh coconut water, and browse small souvenir shops. Walk along the local beach (often free and uncrowded) and observe traditional Maldivian fishing boats (dhonis).
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort before sunset. Watch the sunset from the beach with a budget cocktail or mocktail from the beach bar. Enjoy a romantic beachfront dinner at the resort's more affordable dining option or grab fresh grilled fish from a local eatery if accessible.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet (included if part of package) or grab fresh fruit, bread, and tea from a local café — approx. $5–$10
meals.lunch: Local island café or small restaurant — try mas huni (tuna with coconut) or short eats — approx. $5–$8
meals.dinner: Resort's casual beachfront restaurant or local guesthouse restaurant — grilled fish with rice — approx. $15–$25

day_by_day.notes: Pick up a snorkel gear rental package for the week if available — it saves money versus daily rentals. Ask the resort about free or low-cost house reef snorkeling spots.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling session at the house reef during high tide for the best visibility and marine life activity. Look for sea turtles, reef sharks, and colorful fish. Bring an underwater camera or rent a waterproof case for your phone.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a shared group dolphin-watching cruise (much cheaper than private charters — approx. $20–$35 per person). These typically run in the late afternoon and offer stunning views of spinner dolphins leaping in the open ocean. Combine with a sandbank visit if the tour includes one.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort as the sun sets. Freshen up and enjoy a romantic dinner for two at the resort. Opt for the set menu or daily special to keep costs down. Stargaze from the beach after dinner — the Maldives has minimal light pollution and offers spectacular night skies.

meals.breakfast: Fresh tropical fruit platter, local flatbread (roshi) with scrambled eggs from a local café — approx. $6–$10
meals.lunch: Pack a picnic lunch or grab sandwiches from the resort's deli/café to eat on the sandbank — approx. $8–$12
meals.dinner: Resort set menu dinner or daily special — approx. $20–$35 per person

day_by_day.notes: Book the dolphin cruise through the resort or a local operator the day before to secure spots. Group tours are significantly more budget-friendly than private charters.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga or meditation session on the beach (many resorts offer complimentary or low-cost sessions). Follow with a slow breakfast and a walk along the shoreline collecting shells. Visit the resort's dive center to inquire about a beginner's discover scuba diving session if budget allows (approx. $80–$120 for intro dive).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the underwater world with a guided snorkeling trip to a nearby coral garden or shipwreck snorkel site arranged through a local operator. These shared group tours cost approximately $25–$40 per person and offer incredible biodiversity including moray eels, octopus, and vibrant coral.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience — Witness one of nature's most magical phenomena as the ocean glows electric blue with bioluminescent plankton. This guided night snorkel is a once-in-a-lifetime experience and one of the highlights of the trip. Book in advance as spots are limited.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or local café — coconut pancakes and fresh juice — approx. $7–$12
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort's casual café or beach shack — fish sandwich or tuna wrap — approx. $10–$15
meals.dinner: Early light dinner before the night snorkel — local guesthouse or resort casual dining — approx. $15–$20

day_by_day.notes: The Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience is a must-do and is best experienced on darker nights away from the new moon cycle. Confirm timing and conditions with the operator. Avoid wearing sunscreen during this experience as it harms the plankton.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning after the night snorkel. Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely breakfast. Spend the morning reading on the beach, floating in the lagoon, or exploring tide pools along the shoreline during low tide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a local public ferry to a nearby inhabited island (very affordable — often under $2 each way). Visit the island's Friday mosque (Maldives is predominantly Muslim — dress modestly), explore colorful streets, and chat with friendly locals. Shop for handmade lacquerware, woven mats, or local crafts at very affordable prices.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset fishing trip with a local dhoni (traditional Maldivian boat). This budget-friendly activity (approx. $20–$30 per person on a shared trip) includes traditional hand-line fishing. Many operators will cook your catch for you afterward for a nominal fee — a truly romantic and unique dining experience.

meals.breakfast: Resort or local café — full Maldivian breakfast with mas huni, roshi, and black tea — approx. $5–$10
meals.lunch: Local island eatery — rice and curry with fresh fish — approx. $4–$8 (local islands are much cheaper than resort islands)
meals.dinner: Freshly caught fish cooked by the fishing dhoni operator or at a local guesthouse — approx. $10–$20

day_by_day.notes: Fridays are the holy day in the Maldives. Many local shops close midday for prayers. Dress modestly when visiting local islands — cover shoulders and knees out of respect.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning beach walk to watch the sunrise and look for sea turtles nesting or feeding near the shore. Spend time at the house reef snorkeling independently — this is free and often the best time for calm, clear water. Practice underwater photography.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrange a half-day island hopping tour with a local boat operator (shared group tours approx. $30–$50 per person). Visit multiple uninhabited islands, a sandbank for swimming, and a snorkel spot. These tours offer great value and stunning scenery.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic beach picnic setup — ask the resort if they offer a budget picnic package or arrange your own with items from the resort café. Spread a blanket on the beach, watch the stars emerge, and enjoy a quiet, intimate evening together.

meals.breakfast: Fresh fruit smoothie bowl and toast from the resort café — approx. $8–$12
meals.lunch: Packed lunch provided by island hopping tour or resort-prepared picnic box — approx. $10–$15
meals.dinner: DIY romantic beach picnic with resort-prepared food or takeaway from a local café — approx. $20–$30 for two

day_by_day.notes: For the beach picnic, ask the resort about any complimentary romantic setup options — many resorts offer free or low-cost candles and decorations for honeymooners. Mention your honeymoon status at check-in for potential complimentary upgrades.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint of the trip — treat yourselves to a couple's spa treatment. Look for budget-friendly options like a 30-minute traditional Maldivian massage using coconut oil (approx. $40–$60 per person). Many resorts offer early-bird or off-peak discounts. Alternatively, enjoy a self-care morning with a beach swim and sunbathing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent kayaks or stand-up paddleboards from the resort's water sports center (approx. $15–$25 per hour) and explore the lagoon at your own pace. Paddle to a nearby sandbank or secluded cove for a private swim. This is a wonderfully romantic and active afternoon activity.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the resort's overwater bar or beach bar — splurge slightly on this special midpoint evening. Watch the sky turn pink, orange, and purple as the sun dips below the horizon. Follow with dinner at the resort's signature restaurant for a special midweek treat.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast buffet — fresh pastries, tropical fruits, eggs, and coffee — approx. $10–$18 if not included
meals.lunch: Light beach snack — fresh coconut, fruit skewers, and a cold drink from the beach bar — approx. $10–$15
meals.dinner: Resort signature restaurant — opt for the set menu or catch of the day for the best value — approx. $30–$50 per person

day_by_day.notes: Day 7 is a great day to slightly splurge since it's the midpoint. Balance it with free or low-cost activities like kayaking. Ask about happy hour deals at the beach bar for discounted cocktails.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for a sunrise snorkel at the house reef — the water is typically calmest at dawn and marine life is most active. Look for reef sharks patrolling the drop-off. After snorkeling, enjoy a slow morning with coffee on your beachfront balcony.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local fish market on a nearby inhabited island (accessible by ferry). Watch fishermen bring in their daily catch and interact with locals. This is a fascinating cultural experience that's completely free. Browse local shops for affordable Maldivian snacks, dried fish, and spices to take home.
day_by_day.evening: Join a shared sunset cruise on a traditional dhoni (approx. $25–$40 per person). Sail across the turquoise waters as the sky transforms with color. Many cruises include light snacks and drinks. Return to the resort for a casual dinner.

meals.breakfast: Local café or resort — roshi with egg curry and tea — approx. $5–$10
meals.lunch: Local island eatery near the fish market — very fresh and very affordable — tuna curry with rice — approx. $4–$7
meals.dinner: Resort casual dining or beach grill — grilled barracuda or mahi-mahi with vegetables — approx. $18–$28

day_by_day.notes: Fish markets are typically most active in the early morning and late afternoon when boats return. The local island experience provides authentic Maldivian culture rarely seen by resort-only tourists.

day_by_day.morning: Spend the morning at the beach doing absolutely nothing — this is a vacation! Read books, nap in a hammock, build sandcastles, or simply float in the warm Indian Ocean. Embrace the slow pace of island life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrange a snorkeling trip to a manta ray cleaning station or whale shark snorkel spot (seasonal — check availability). These shared group marine experiences cost approx. $40–$70 per person and are absolutely unforgettable. Manta rays and whale sharks are gentle giants that snorkelers can safely observe.
day_by_day.evening: Cooking class at the resort or with a local chef on a nearby island — learn to make traditional Maldivian dishes like garudhiya (fish soup), mas riha (fish curry), and bondibai (rice pudding). This intimate experience costs approx. $30–$50 per person and includes dinner.

meals.breakfast: Tropical smoothie and granola from the resort café — approx. $8–$12
meals.lunch: Beach picnic or resort snack bar — fresh sandwiches and cold drinks — approx. $10–$15
meals.dinner: Dishes prepared during the cooking class — included in the class cost

day_by_day.notes: Whale shark and manta ray sightings are seasonal and location-dependent. Ask your resort or local operators about current sighting reports. These experiences are worth every penny for nature lovers.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning birdwatching walk around the island — the Maldives hosts several unique bird species including herons, terns, and the white-tailed tropicbird. This is a free activity that connects you with the island's natural ecosystem. Bring binoculars if you have them.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the resort's swimming pool or lagoon beach. Take turns giving each other beach massages with coconut oil purchased from a local shop. Enjoy the resort's amenities fully — lounge chairs, beach swings, and water hammocks.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a private beach dinner setup if budget allows (many resorts offer this for $50–$100 extra — a worthwhile splurge for honeymooners). Candles, flower petals, a dedicated server, and a personalized menu create an unforgettable romantic experience under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or local café — fresh papaya, pineapple, and local flatbread — approx. $6–$10
meals.lunch: Resort beach bar — light salad, fish tacos, or a fresh coconut — approx. $12–$18
meals.dinner: Private beach dinner or resort restaurant — budget $40–$70 per person for a special evening

day_by_day.notes: Book the private beach dinner at least 2 days in advance. Mention it's your honeymoon — resorts often add complimentary touches like rose petals, a small cake, or a bottle of sparkling wine.

day_by_day.morning: Final big snorkeling adventure — revisit your favorite reef spot or ask the resort to recommend a new location you haven't explored yet. Spend 2–3 hours underwater, taking photos and saying goodbye to the incredible marine life. Look for nudibranchs, sea stars, and lionfish in the coral crevices.
day_by_day.afternoon: Souvenir shopping and gift buying. Visit a local island's market for handmade crafts, lacquerware boxes, woven mats, and local spices. These make meaningful and affordable gifts. Budget approx. $20–$50 for souvenirs. Also pick up local snacks like dried tuna chips and coconut sweets.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a Boduberu performance if available — this traditional Maldivian music and dance form features large drums and energetic dancing. Many resorts or local cultural centers host these performances. It's a wonderful way to connect with Maldivian culture. Follow with a casual dinner.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast to fuel the morning snorkel — approx. $10–$18 if not included
meals.lunch: Local island café during souvenir shopping — short eats and fresh juice — approx. $5–$8
meals.dinner: Resort casual restaurant or local guesthouse — Maldivian curry night — approx. $15–$25

day_by_day.notes: Check with your resort about scheduled cultural performances during your stay. Boduberu performances are authentic cultural experiences that are often free or very low cost to attend.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise walk on the beach — take photos, collect shells, and soak in every last moment of paradise. Write postcards or journal entries about your trip. Take a final dip in the crystal-clear lagoon and snorkel the house reef one last time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pack bags and prepare for departure. Check out of the room (or arrange a late checkout if available — ask the resort). Store luggage with the concierge. Spend remaining time at the pool or beach. Take final photos around the resort.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at the resort — choose a slightly special restaurant to close out the trip on a high note. Toast to your incredible Maldivian adventure. Arrange your transfer to the airport or speedboat jetty for your departure.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — make it a full meal since it may be your last included one — approx. $10–$18 if not included
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort café or beach bar — keep it simple — approx. $10–$15
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at the resort's best casual restaurant — treat yourselves to a final Maldivian feast — approx. $25–$45 per person

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your departure transfer timing with the resort at least 24 hours before. Speedboat and ferry schedules to the airport need to be coordinated carefully. Allow extra time for transfers as island logistics can be unpredictable.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning departure preparation if flight is in the morning. Enjoy a final coffee on the beach or balcony. Complete any last-minute shopping at the airport duty-free for Maldivian vanilla, local honey, or crafts. Velana International Airport has a small shopping area with local products.
day_by_day.afternoon: Departure from Velana International Airport. Reflect on 13 unforgettable days in paradise — the bioluminescent night snorkel, dolphin watching, sandbank picnics, local island adventures, and romantic sunsets. Carry these memories home as your greatest souvenir.
day_by_day.evening: In transit home — relive favorite moments by going through photos and videos. Begin planning your next adventure.

meals.breakfast: Airport café or light snack before boarding — approx. $8–$15
meals.lunch: On the flight or airport restaurant
meals.dinner: On the flight

day_by_day.notes: Keep some USD for airport taxes or last-minute expenses. Arrive at the airport at least 2.5–3 hours before international departure. Take one last look at the turquoise waters from the airport — the Maldives will always call you back.

trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: No activities — flight in transit
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities — flight in transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrival at Velana International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Clear immigration, collect luggage, and meet the Aegean Bliss Resort transfer representative. Board the resort's speedboat or seaplane transfer to the resort. Check in to your Beachfront villa, freshen up, and enjoy a welcome drink prepared by the resort staff. Take a quiet stroll along the moonlit beach to unwind after the journey.

meals.breakfast: In-flight meal
meals.lunch: In-flight meal
meals.dinner: Light welcome snack platter and tropical fruit basket provided at villa upon check-in — complimentary resort welcome amenity

day_by_day.notes: Late arrival — keep Day 1 completely relaxed. Confirm transfer arrangements with Aegean Bliss Resort at least 48 hours before arrival. Pack a small carry-on with essentials (swimwear, charger, toiletries) in case checked luggage is delayed. Resort check-in is available 24/7.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely start. After waking, take your first morning swim directly from your beachfront villa. Explore the resort grounds, locate the house reef entry point, and get oriented with the resort map. Enjoy a relaxed breakfast at the resort's main restaurant overlooking the lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the resort's water sports center and rent snorkeling gear for a self-guided house reef snorkel session. The house reef surrounding Aegean Bliss Resort is teeming with colorful parrotfish, clownfish, and coral formations. Spend 1–2 hours in the water, then relax on your private beachfront sunloungers. Visit the resort spa for a brief consultation and book your Underwater Spa Treatment for Two for a later date.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the sunset from your villa's private terrace with a bottle of chilled rosé (available from the resort's in-villa minibar or room service). Dress for a romantic beachside dinner at the resort's signature à la carte restaurant. Toast to your arrival in paradise.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's main restaurant — tropical fruits, eggs made to order, pastries, fresh juices (included or mid-range resort rate)
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch at the resort's beach bar — grilled fish wraps, fresh coconut, and a tropical smoothie (~$20–35 per person)
meals.dinner: Romantic dinner at the resort's signature à la carte restaurant — grilled lobster or catch of the day, paired with a glass of house wine (~$60–90 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: Day 2 is intentionally slow-paced to recover from jet lag and the late arrival. Use this day to fully settle in, explore the resort, and plan the rest of your trip. Ask the resort concierge about tide schedules for optimal snorkeling times throughout your stay.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for the best snorkeling conditions. Join the guided Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari — a half-day excursion departing from the resort's jetty. Explore the Maldives' most vibrant coral gardens with expert marine biologists as guides. Spot sea turtles gliding through the reef, white-tip reef sharks resting on the sandy bottom, and schools of colorful reef fish. Snorkeling equipment is provided.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort by early afternoon. Rinse off and enjoy a light lunch at the beach bar. Spend the afternoon relaxing on your beachfront — read, nap in a hammock, or take a kayak out on the calm lagoon waters. As the sun softens, take a romantic couples' walk along the sandbank at low tide.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy pre-dinner cocktails at the resort's overwater bar — order the signature Maldivian Sunset cocktail made with local passion fruit and coconut rum. Dine at the resort's casual beachside grill for a relaxed evening under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the safari — grab fresh fruit, yogurt, and coffee from the resort's grab-and-go station or buffet
meals.lunch: Beach bar lunch post-safari — grilled reef fish, fresh salad, and coconut water (~$25–40 per person)
meals.dinner: Casual beachside grill dinner — BBQ skewers, grilled prawns, and local Maldivian curry with roti (~$45–70 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: The Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari typically runs 3–4 hours. Wear reef-safe sunscreen only (no oxybenzone or octinoxate) to protect the coral ecosystem — many resorts enforce this policy. Book this experience through the resort's activity desk at least one day in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the morning with a couples' yoga session on the beach at sunrise — check with the resort's wellness center for scheduled sessions (usually 7:00–8:00 AM). After yoga, take a refreshing dip in the Indian Ocean directly from your beachfront. Enjoy a slow, indulgent breakfast back at the main restaurant.
day_by_day.afternoon: Treat yourselves to the Underwater Spa Treatment for Two — an iconic Maldivian luxury experience. Enjoy a full couples' massage and spa ritual in an underwater treatment room with panoramic views of the coral reef and marine life swimming past the glass walls. This is one of the most romantic and unique experiences in the world. The treatment typically lasts 90–120 minutes.
day_by_day.evening: After your spa afternoon, slip into something elegant and head to the resort's overwater lounge for sunset aperitifs. Dine at the resort's fine dining restaurant for a special honeymoon dinner — inform the restaurant in advance so they can arrange rose petals, candles, and a personalized menu.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely full buffet breakfast — freshly baked croissants, smoked salmon, tropical fruit platters, and barista coffee
meals.lunch: Light in-spa refreshments or a healthy spa lunch menu — detox juices, avocado toast, and fruit bowls (~$15–25 per person)
meals.dinner: Fine dining restaurant at Aegean Bliss Resort — 4-course tasting menu with wine pairing (~$120–160 per couple, splurge-worthy for honeymoon)

day_by_day.notes: Book the Underwater Spa Treatment for Two well in advance as it is one of the most sought-after experiences at any Maldivian resort. Inform the spa of any allergies or preferences. This is an ideal day to splurge slightly given the once-in-a-lifetime nature of the experience. Request honeymoon amenities (flower bath, champagne) if not already arranged by the resort.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a free morning at your own pace — sleep in, order in-villa breakfast, and spend time on your private beachfront terrace. Take a leisurely swim in the resort pool or the lagoon. Browse the resort boutique for local crafts and souvenirs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join the Maldivian Cooking Class and Beachside Dinner experience. In the afternoon session, head to a secluded beach with a local Maldivian chef. Learn to prepare traditional dishes including Mas Huni (tuna and coconut), Garudhiya (fish broth), and fresh coconut sambal. Discover the spices, techniques, and stories behind Maldivian culinary heritage.
day_by_day.evening: The cooking class culminates in a private beachside dinner where you enjoy the meal you prepared together — set up with lanterns, candles, and the sound of the Indian Ocean lapping the shore. A truly romantic and immersive honeymoon evening. Pair your dinner with a bottle of chilled white wine.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast ordered via room service — fresh fruit platter, eggs Benedict, fresh orange juice, and coffee (~$30–45 per couple, or included in some resort packages)
meals.lunch: Light snack at the resort beach bar — bruschetta, fresh coconut, and tropical juice (~$15–20 per person)
meals.dinner: Included in the Maldivian Cooking Class and Beachside Dinner experience — your own handcrafted Maldivian feast on a private beach

day_by_day.notes: The Maldivian Cooking Class and Beachside Dinner is a combined afternoon-into-evening experience. Confirm the start time with the activity desk — usually begins around 3:30–4:00 PM and concludes with dinner around 7:30–8:30 PM. Wear comfortable clothes you don't mind getting a little sandy or splashed.

day_by_day.morning: Take an early morning guided snorkel session at the house reef — early morning is the best time to spot manta rays and sea turtles feeding near the surface. Bring an underwater camera or GoPro to capture the marine life. After snorkeling, enjoy a beachside breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrange a half-day island-hopping excursion through the resort's activity desk to visit a local Maldivian fishing village. Experience authentic local life, visit the colorful local market, and see traditional boat-building. This provides a meaningful cultural contrast to the resort bubble. Return to the resort by late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Book the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditionally decorated Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered just for the two of you. Sip champagne as the sky turns shades of orange, pink, and purple. The crew will ensure a completely romantic and intimate experience on the water.

meals.breakfast: Beachside breakfast after the morning snorkel — açaí bowls, fresh fruit, granola, and cold brew coffee at the resort's beach café (~$20–30 per person)
meals.lunch: Lunch at the local island during the cultural excursion — try a traditional Maldivian short eats (hedhikaa) spread at a local tea house (~$5–10 per person, very affordable)
meals.dinner: Champagne and canapés included on the Sunset Dhoni Cruise. Follow up with a light dinner at the resort's casual restaurant upon return — grilled fish of the day with coconut rice (~$50–65 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise typically lasts 1.5–2 hours and departs approximately 1 hour before sunset. Check the sunset time for March 20 in the Maldives (approximately 18:15–18:30 local time) and book accordingly. The local island visit requires modest dress — carry a light scarf or sarong to cover shoulders and knees out of respect for local customs.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint rest and rejuvenation day. Enjoy a completely unscheduled morning — lie in, order a lavish in-villa breakfast, and simply be present together. Take a slow walk around the entire island perimeter along the water's edge.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the resort's infinity pool with cocktails in hand. Try stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) on the lagoon — available through the water sports center at no extra charge for resort guests in most mid-range resorts. Alternatively, relax in the shade with a good book.
day_by_day.evening: Visit the resort's overwater bar for the weekly local cultural show — many Maldivian resorts host traditional Bodu Beru drumming and dance performances on Saturday or Sunday evenings. Enjoy dinner at the resort's buffet night (many resorts host themed buffets on weekends) featuring international and local cuisine.

meals.breakfast: Indulgent in-villa breakfast — eggs any style, pancakes with fresh mango compote, cold-pressed juice, and a pot of Maldivian tea
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch — club sandwich, sweet potato fries, and a frozen piña colada (~$25–35 per person)
meals.dinner: Weekend seafood buffet at the resort's main restaurant — fresh grilled seafood, sushi station, Maldivian curry corner, and live cooking stations (~$55–75 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Day 7 is intentionally unscheduled as a midpoint reset. Resist the urge to over-plan — some of the best honeymoon memories come from unstructured time spent together. Ask the concierge about the weekly cultural performance schedule.

day_by_day.morning: Join a guided dolphin watching excursion — one of the Maldives' most beloved wildlife experiences. Depart by speedboat in the early morning when spinner dolphins are most active. Watch pods of dolphins leap and spin alongside the boat in the open ocean. Return to the resort by mid-morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend a relaxing afternoon at the resort's spa — book individual treatments such as a traditional Maldivian coconut oil massage or a hot stone therapy session. Alternatively, explore the resort's snorkeling trail with the underwater map provided by the dive center to discover specific coral formations and fish species.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic private dinner on your villa's beachfront terrace — arrange this in advance with the resort's dining team. A personal butler will set up a candlelit table with flower arrangements directly on the sand outside your villa. A dedicated server will present a curated 3-course menu.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the dolphin excursion — banana, granola bar, and coffee from the resort's grab-and-go station
meals.lunch: Post-excursion lunch at the beach bar — fish tacos, fresh lime soda, and tropical fruit skewers (~$25–35 per person)
meals.dinner: Private in-villa beachfront dinner — 3-course set menu (seafood bisque, grilled mahi-mahi with herb butter, chocolate lava cake) with a bottle of wine (~$100–130 per couple including setup fee)

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin watching excursions are not guaranteed wildlife encounters, but spinner dolphins are extremely common in the Maldives and sightings are frequent. The private beachfront dinner must be arranged at least 24 hours in advance with the resort's concierge or dining team. Specify any dietary restrictions or wine preferences.

day_by_day.morning: Take a guided scuba diving introductory session if neither of you has dived before — the resort's PADI dive center offers Discover Scuba Diving experiences for beginners in the calm, shallow lagoon. This is a life-changing experience in the crystal-clear Maldivian waters. If already certified, join a guided reef dive.
day_by_day.afternoon: After diving, enjoy a leisurely afternoon. Visit the resort's boutique or gift shop to pick up locally made souvenirs — Maldivian lacquerwork, woven mats, or handmade jewelry. Relax by the pool and enjoy afternoon tea served at the poolside lounge.
day_by_day.evening: Head to the Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience — one of the most magical and otherworldly experiences available in the Maldives. Wade into the warm Indian Ocean after dark and witness the water glowing electric blue as bioluminescent plankton light up with every movement. A guided, intimate experience that feels truly surreal and deeply romantic.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast before the diving session — high-protein options including eggs, smoked fish, and whole grain toast for energy
meals.lunch: Light post-dive lunch — fresh tuna salad, sparkling water, and coconut pudding at the beach café (~$20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: Casual resort restaurant dinner before the night snorkeling experience — keep it light with grilled chicken, steamed vegetables, and fresh juice (~$40–55 per couple). The night snorkeling experience usually includes light refreshments.

day_by_day.notes: The Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience is weather and season dependent — bioluminescence is most visible on darker, moonless nights. March typically has favorable conditions. The experience is usually 60–90 minutes and guided by experts. Avoid wearing sunscreen or repellent into the water during this experience as it can affect the plankton. This is an absolute must-do highlight of the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow, romantic morning together. Order in-villa breakfast and spend the morning in your private outdoor space — swim in the warm Indian Ocean just steps from your villa, sunbathe on your personal stretch of beach, and simply enjoy each other's company without a schedule.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrange a private sandbank picnic through the resort — a quintessential Maldivian luxury experience. A boat takes you to a tiny, uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the ocean where a private picnic setup awaits: a canopied table, chilled champagne, gourmet sandwiches, tropical fruits, and fresh seafood. You'll have the entire sandbank to yourselves.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort in the late afternoon. Freshen up and enjoy sunset cocktails on your villa terrace. Dine at the resort's Asian fusion restaurant (if available) or the overwater restaurant for a change of scenery and cuisine.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — fresh tropical fruit platter, yogurt parfait, croissants with Maldivian honey, and freshly brewed coffee
meals.lunch: Private sandbank picnic — gourmet picnic basket with champagne, charcuterie, fresh seafood, tropical fruits, and artisan chocolates (typically ~$80–120 per couple as a resort excursion)
meals.dinner: Overwater or Asian fusion restaurant at the resort — sushi platter, tempura prawns, and miso-glazed fish with sake or cocktails (~$65–90 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: The private sandbank picnic must be booked at least 2 days in advance and is subject to weather and tidal conditions. March weather in the Maldives is generally excellent (dry season) making this very likely to proceed. This is one of the most photographed and memorable experiences of a Maldives honeymoon — bring your camera.

day_by_day.morning: Join a morning guided kayaking tour around the island's lagoon — explore mangrove channels and hidden coves accessible only by kayak. The calm morning waters make this a peaceful and scenic experience. Spot herons, kingfishers, and reef fish in the shallows.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari for a second visit — experienced snorkelers will notice new marine life and different sections of the reef. Alternatively, spend the afternoon at the resort's spa with individual treatments not yet experienced — try a Maldivian traditional healing treatment using local herbs and coconut.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — or if you prefer something different, arrange a stargazing experience on the beach with the resort's astronomy guide (some resorts offer this). The Maldives' remote location and minimal light pollution make for extraordinary stargazing. End the evening with a nightcap at the overwater bar.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast with a focus on energy — fresh juices, tropical fruits, eggs, and whole grain options before the active morning
meals.lunch: Beach bar lunch — grilled barracuda burger, sweet potato chips, and fresh lemonade (~$25–35 per person)
meals.dinner: Casual resort grill dinner — mixed seafood platter for two with garlic butter, salad, and local flatbread (~$55–75 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: Day 11 is a great day to revisit favorite experiences or try something not yet done. If opting for stargazing instead of the Sunset Dhoni Cruise, book this through the concierge in advance as guides may need to be arranged. The Maldives' location near the equator provides exceptional views of the Southern Cross and other constellations rarely visible from the Northern Hemisphere.

day_by_day.morning: Final full day — make it count. Wake up early for one last magical sunrise on the beach together. Bring two cups of coffee from the in-villa machine and watch the sky transform over the Indian Ocean. Take a final snorkel session at the house reef to say goodbye to your underwater neighbors.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon doing last-minute souvenir shopping at the resort boutique and packing thoughtfully. Take a final swim in the resort pool and enjoy afternoon tea at the poolside lounge. Arrange for the resort photographer (if available) to take a final couple's photo session on the beach during the golden hour.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate your final evening in the Maldives with a special farewell dinner. Return to the fine dining restaurant that made an impression earlier in the trip, or request a special chef's table experience. Reflect on the journey, the memories made, and the magic of your honeymoon. Toast with a bottle of champagne.

meals.breakfast: Sunrise in-villa coffee and light snacks, followed by a full buffet breakfast at the main restaurant — indulge in everything you've loved throughout the trip
meals.lunch: Light beach lunch — fresh coconut, fruit skewers, and a cold sandwich from the beach bar (~$15–20 per person) to save appetite for the farewell dinner
meals.dinner: Farewell honeymoon dinner at the resort's finest restaurant — 5-course chef's tasting menu with champagne toast (~$150–180 per couple, a worthy final splurge)

day_by_day.notes: Arrange checkout logistics and transfer details with the concierge today. Confirm your departure transfer time and method. Pack any reef-safe sunscreen, snorkeling gear rentals should be returned, and check for any items left in the villa safe. Many resorts offer a late checkout option — inquire about this if your departure transfer allows.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning — enjoy a leisurely last breakfast at the resort. Take one final walk along your beachfront, dip your toes in the Indian Ocean one last time, and soak in the beauty of the Maldives. Check out of your villa and store luggage with the resort's bell service while awaiting your transfer.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your departure flight time, spend remaining time at the resort's lounge or pool area (many resorts offer day-use facilities post-checkout for departing guests). When transfer time arrives, board the resort's speedboat or seaplane back to Velana International Airport. Cherish the aerial or water-level views of the atolls one final time.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Velana International Airport. Carry the memories of your Maldives honeymoon — the bioluminescent nights, the coral gardens, the champagne sunsets, and the quiet moments together on the edge of the Indian Ocean.

meals.breakfast: Final full breakfast at the resort — order everything you loved and haven't had enough of. Make it a proper farewell feast.
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort lounge or airport — airport dining options at Velana International Airport include local Maldivian dishes and international options (~$15–25 per person)
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or airport dining depending on departure time

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before your international flight departure for the resort-to-airport transfer plus check-in and security. Seaplane transfers operate only during daylight hours — if your flight departs early morning or late evening, a speedboat transfer will be used instead. Declare any duty-free purchases and ensure all souvenirs comply with customs regulations. Carry your coral-safe sunscreen and any reef-safe products home — they make wonderful reminders of your commitment to ocean conservation.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered for two. Watch the sun melt into the horizon while sipping champagne and enjoying a curated platter of local and international canapés. A quintessential romantic experience perfect for honeymooners seeking intimacy and breathtaking natural beauty.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore some of the Maldives' most vibrant coral gardens teeming with sea turtles, reef sharks, manta rays, and thousands of tropical fish. A guided snorkeling safari takes you to three pristine reef sites across the atoll, with a marine biologist on hand to narrate the underwater world. Snorkeling gear and a light tropical lunch on a sandbank are included.
experiences.location: Baa Atoll UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, Maldives

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in a couples' massage and spa ritual at one of the world's most iconic underwater spa facilities. Set beneath the ocean surface with panoramic glass walls revealing the reef ecosystem, this luxurious 90-minute treatment uses locally sourced coconut oil and tropical botanicals. An unparalleled honeymoon splurge that blends wellness with the magic of the sea.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Maldivian Cooking Class and Beachside Dinner
experiences.description: Learn the art of traditional Maldivian cuisine with a local chef on a secluded beach. Discover how to prepare dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish broth, and coconut-infused curries using fresh island ingredients. The class concludes with a romantic candlelit dinner for two on the beach under a canopy of stars, with the sound of gentle waves as your backdrop.
experiences.location: Maafushi Island, South Malé Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience
experiences.description: Witness one of nature's most magical phenomena as the ocean glows electric blue with bioluminescent plankton after dark. Guided by expert marine naturalists, wade into the warm shallows and snorkel through a living light show that feels otherworldly. This rare and deeply romantic experience is unique to certain Maldivian islands and creates memories that last a lifetime for honeymooning couples.

day_by_day.morning: No activities — flight in transit
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities — flight in transit
day_by_day.evening: Late arrival at Malé Velana International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. A dedicated Aegean Bliss Resort butler will greet you at the arrivals hall with a welcome garland and chilled towels. Transfer via private luxury speedboat to Aegean Bliss Resort (approximately 30–45 minutes depending on location). Enjoy complimentary welcome cocktails and a light midnight snack prepared by the resort chef upon arrival. Check into your Beachfront villa, where rose petals, candles, and a chilled bottle of Champagne await as a honeymoon welcome.

meals.breakfast: In-flight
meals.lunch: In-flight
meals.dinner: Late-night welcome amenity: curated charcuterie board, tropical fruit platter, and Champagne in the villa — compliments of Aegean Bliss Resort

day_by_day.notes: Given the late arrival, no formal activities are scheduled for Day 1. Ensure all resort pre-arrival preferences (pillow menu, dietary restrictions, honeymoon surprises) are communicated to the resort concierge at least 48 hours before landing. The private speedboat transfer should be pre-arranged with the resort.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely start to your honeymoon. Indulge in a lavish in-villa breakfast served on your private deck overlooking the Indian Ocean — freshly squeezed tropical juices, eggs cooked to order, pastries, and local Maldivian short eats. Take a gentle stroll along the resort's pristine white-sand beach to get your bearings and soak in the breathtaking surroundings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Orientation tour of Aegean Bliss Resort with your personal butler. Explore the resort's amenities — the infinity pool, overwater bar, spa, and water sports center. Spend the afternoon unwinding at the beachfront pool with curated cocktails and light bites. Optionally, take a complimentary kayak or paddleboard out on the calm lagoon waters surrounding your villa.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne: Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered exclusively for you both. Toast to your honeymoon with chilled Champagne as the sky transforms into shades of amber, rose, and violet. The crew will serve canapés and fresh tropical fruits as you drift across the glassy ocean at golden hour.

meals.breakfast: In-villa private breakfast on the deck — à la carte from the resort's gourmet morning menu
meals.lunch: Casual poolside dining at the resort's Lagoon Terrace Restaurant — grilled seafood platters, fresh salads, and tropical smoothies
meals.dinner: Romantic beachside dinner for two at the resort's signature fine-dining restaurant — tasting menu featuring locally caught fish, lobster thermidor, and a decadent dessert platter with a honeymoon cake

day_by_day.notes: Book the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise through the resort concierge upon arrival. Sunset in the Maldives in March typically occurs around 18:15–18:30. Request the dhoni cruise to depart around 17:30 to capture the full golden hour experience.

day_by_day.morning: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari (Morning Session): Embark on a guided snorkeling expedition to explore some of the Maldives' most vibrant coral gardens. Your expert marine biologist guide will lead you through thriving reef ecosystems teeming with sea turtles, reef sharks, manta rays, and hundreds of species of tropical fish. High-quality snorkeling gear, wetsuits, and underwater cameras are provided. The boat departs from the resort's jetty.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and enjoy a refreshing freshwater shower followed by a relaxed afternoon on your private beachfront. Order a curated 'Reef to Table' lunch at the resort's beachside shack. Spend the afternoon lounging on your villa's private sun deck, reading, or exploring the resort's overwater boutique for local crafts and souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Couples' cocktail masterclass at the resort's overwater bar — learn to mix classic Maldivian-inspired cocktails using local ingredients like coconut, pandan, and tropical fruits with the resort's head mixologist. Watch the stars emerge over the Indian Ocean as you sip your creations.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort's main restaurant — extensive spread including live cooking stations, fresh tropical fruits, and Maldivian breakfast staples like mas huni (tuna and coconut) with roshi flatbread
meals.lunch: Beachside 'Reef to Table' lunch — grilled catch of the day, coconut rice, and fresh papaya salad
meals.dinner: Overwater restaurant dinner — premium sushi and sashimi omakase menu with sake pairing, followed by a dessert of warm chocolate lava cake with vanilla bean ice cream

day_by_day.notes: The Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari is best experienced in the morning when visibility is at its peak and marine life is most active. Apply reef-safe sunscreen only, as the resort enforces strict marine conservation policies. Book through the resort's water sports center the evening before.

day_by_day.morning: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two: Begin the day with the resort's most iconic experience — a couples' massage and spa ritual at the stunning underwater spa facility. Surrounded by panoramic views of the ocean floor, tropical fish, and coral formations through floor-to-ceiling glass panels, you'll receive a 90-minute Balinese couples' massage followed by a Maldivian coconut and sea salt body scrub. A post-treatment relaxation lounge with herbal teas and fresh fruit awaits.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort's private lagoon on a guided stand-up paddleboard tour. Alternatively, enjoy a private yoga session on the beach or your villa deck with the resort's in-house wellness instructor. Spend the mid-afternoon in the resort's temperature-controlled infinity pool with ocean views.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the resort's iconic overwater bar perched above the lagoon. As dusk settles, move to a candlelit dinner on the beach — a private table set up just for the two of you at the water's edge, with the sound of gentle waves as your soundtrack.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — continental spread with freshly baked croissants, smoked salmon, tropical fruit bowls, and specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Light spa lunch at the spa lounge — detox green juices, quinoa salad, and chilled coconut water
meals.dinner: Private candlelit beach dinner — five-course gourmet menu featuring lobster bisque, beef tenderloin with truffle jus, and a signature Maldivian dessert of pandan panna cotta

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Spa Treatment must be booked well in advance as slots are extremely limited. Request a morning appointment (around 09:00–10:30) to make the most of the day. Inform the spa of any allergies or skin sensitivities before the treatment.

day_by_day.morning: Maldivian Cooking Class and Beachside Dinner Preparation: Join a local Maldivian chef on a secluded stretch of beach for an immersive cooking class. Discover the art of traditional Maldivian cuisine — learn to prepare garudhiya (fish broth), mas riha (fish curry), and freshly made roshi flatbread using locally sourced ingredients. The class includes a visit to the resort's herb and spice garden.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the cooking class, take a private chartered snorkeling excursion to a nearby uninhabited sandbank. Wade in crystal-clear shallow waters, collect shells, and enjoy a private Champagne picnic set up by the resort team on the sandbank — complete with a sun umbrella, plush towels, and a chilled seafood platter.
day_by_day.evening: Beachside Dinner: Enjoy the fruits of your morning cooking class as the dishes you prepared are elegantly presented by the resort's culinary team for a personalized beachside dinner. The chef adds finishing touches and pairs each dish with curated wines from the resort's cellar.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort's main restaurant — include local Maldivian specialties alongside international options
meals.lunch: Private sandbank Champagne picnic — chilled lobster, prawn cocktail, artisan cheeses, fresh baguettes, and tropical fruit
meals.dinner: Beachside dinner featuring your personally prepared Maldivian dishes — garudhiya, mas riha, roshi, and a traditional coconut sweet for dessert, paired with Sauvignon Blanc and a local coconut toddy

day_by_day.notes: The sandbank excursion is tide-dependent — confirm timing with the resort concierge the evening before. Bring reef-safe sunscreen and a light cover-up for the sandbank visit. The cooking class typically runs for 2–3 hours.

day_by_day.morning: Leisure morning — sleep in, enjoy a slow breakfast, and spend time in your beachfront villa. Take a morning dip in your private plunge pool or the resort's main infinity pool. Arrange a private guided dolphin-watching boat excursion departing mid-morning — the waters around the Maldives are home to large pods of spinner dolphins that are active in the morning hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from the dolphin-watching excursion and spend a relaxed afternoon at the resort's beach club. Enjoy complimentary water sports — try windsurfing, snorkeling in the house reef, or a fun banana boat ride. Order refreshing mocktails and smoothies from the beach club's service team.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne (Second Experience): Take a second sunset cruise — this time exploring a different route around the atoll, watching for manta rays and flying fish as the sun dips below the horizon. A curated grazing board of charcuterie, cheeses, and tropical fruits accompanies your Champagne.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — eggs Benedict with smoked Maldivian tuna, fresh orange juice, and a selection of pastries
meals.lunch: Beach club lunch — gourmet burgers, truffle fries, fresh coconut, and a tropical fruit platter
meals.dinner: Fine dining at the resort's overwater restaurant — grilled whole lobster with garlic butter, saffron risotto, and a decadent chocolate fondant dessert with raspberry coulis

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin-watching excursions are best in the early morning (07:00–09:00) when dolphins are most active. Book through the resort's water sports center. The second Sunset Dhoni Cruise can be customized — request a different route or additional decorations to make it unique.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day relaxation and wellness day. Begin with a private sunrise yoga session on the beach at 06:30, guided by the resort's wellness instructor. Follow with a refreshing morning swim in the lagoon. Spend the late morning at the resort's spa — enjoy individual treatments such as a deep tissue massage, facial, or Ayurvedic head massage.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon exploring the resort's overwater bungalow area on a guided kayak tour through the stilted pathways. Alternatively, visit the resort's marine biology center to learn about local coral restoration efforts and adopt a coral fragment as a meaningful honeymoon memento. Relax on the villa deck with a good book and room service refreshments.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience: As darkness falls, slip into the warm Indian Ocean for one of nature's most magical phenomena. Guided by expert marine naturalists, witness the ocean glowing electric blue with bioluminescent plankton as you move through the water. Every stroke of your hand and kick of your fins creates trails of ethereal blue light in the darkness.

meals.breakfast: Light post-yoga breakfast at the spa lounge — acai bowls, green smoothies, chia pudding, and herbal teas
meals.lunch: In-villa private lunch — Mediterranean mezze platter with hummus, grilled vegetables, pita, and a chilled rosé wine
meals.dinner: Pre-snorkeling light dinner at the resort's casual bistro — fresh seafood pasta, Caesar salad, and a glass of crisp white wine to prepare for the evening adventure

day_by_day.notes: The Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience is weather and plankton-dependent. March is generally an excellent month for this phenomenon in the Maldives. The experience typically departs at around 21:00 and lasts 60–90 minutes. Wear a swimsuit and bring a light towel — the resort provides all snorkeling equipment.

day_by_day.morning: Day excursion to a local Maldivian fishing village on a nearby inhabited island. Your resort will arrange a private boat transfer to experience authentic Maldivian culture — visit the local mosque, browse the colorful market stalls, and interact with friendly locals. Purchase handmade lacquerwork, woven baskets, and traditional crafts as souvenirs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort by early afternoon. Enjoy a leisurely afternoon at the resort's beach, alternating between swimming, sunbathing, and sipping refreshing drinks from the beach butler service. Try a new water sport — perhaps parasailing for a bird's-eye view of the stunning atoll.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic in-villa dinner experience: The resort's culinary team transforms your villa's private deck into an intimate dining room — white linen tablecloth, floating candles, and fairy lights strung overhead. A private chef prepares a personalized five-course tasting menu at your table, with a sommelier on hand to guide wine pairings.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the main restaurant before the village excursion — fuel up with a hearty spread
meals.lunch: Authentic local lunch at a family-run eatery on the inhabited island — traditional Maldivian fish curry, rice, and freshly made short eats (hedhikaa)
meals.dinner: Private in-villa five-course tasting menu — amuse-bouche, seared scallops, lobster bisque, wagyu beef tenderloin, and a bespoke honeymoon dessert

day_by_day.notes: The local village visit requires modest clothing — pack light scarves or cover-ups to respect local customs. Photography in the village should be done respectfully and with permission. Arrange the in-villa private dinner experience with the resort concierge at least 24 hours in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari (Second Session — Different Location): Return to the water for a second guided snorkeling safari, this time exploring a completely different coral garden in a more remote part of the atoll. Your marine biologist guide will take you to a site known for hammerhead shark sightings, eagle rays, and vast fields of staghorn coral. Underwater photography service available.
day_by_day.afternoon: Post-snorkeling relaxation at the resort's adults-only pool terrace. Enjoy a couples' cocktail hour with a curated 'Maldivian Botanicals' drinks menu. Visit the resort's overwater boutique and browse luxury brands and locally inspired jewelry. Consider purchasing a piece of Maldivian black coral jewelry as a honeymoon keepsake.
day_by_day.evening: Stargazing experience on the beach: The resort's astronomy guide sets up high-powered telescopes on the beach after dark. With virtually zero light pollution, the Maldivian night sky is one of the most spectacular in the world. Identify constellations, planets, and the Milky Way while sipping warm spiced chai and wrapped in plush resort blankets.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — tropical fruit smoothie bowl, avocado toast on sourdough, and freshly brewed specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch at the adults-only terrace — sushi rolls, miso soup, edamame, and Japanese-inspired small plates
meals.dinner: Overwater restaurant dinner — themed 'Ocean to Plate' menu featuring a raw bar with oysters, ceviche, and sashimi, followed by a whole grilled snapper with coconut sambal and pandan rice

day_by_day.notes: The second snorkeling safari to the remote site may require a slightly longer boat journey (20–30 minutes). Bring motion sickness medication if needed. The stargazing experience is best on a new moon night — check the lunar calendar and request the optimal date from the concierge.

day_by_day.morning: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two (Extended Session): Return to the iconic underwater spa for a longer, more indulgent couples' ritual. This extended session includes a hot stone massage, a Maldivian volcanic sand body wrap, and a private Jacuzzi session overlooking the ocean floor. The spa team creates a bespoke aromatherapy blend using local flowers and essential oils.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon on a private catamaran sailing experience around the atoll — sip chilled rosé, sunbathe on the deck netting, and snorkel at a secluded spot accessible only by boat. The catamaran is exclusively chartered for you with a dedicated crew.
day_by_day.evening: Couples' private cooking and cocktail evening at the resort's culinary studio — a more advanced session where the executive chef guides you through preparing a three-course gourmet meal together. Pair your dishes with cocktails crafted by the resort's mixologist using local spirits and botanicals.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast — leisurely morning with fresh juices, pastries, and a live egg station
meals.lunch: Catered lunch on the catamaran — gourmet sandwiches, fresh fruit, cheese board, and chilled Champagne
meals.dinner: The three-course meal you prepare together in the culinary studio — starter, main, and dessert of your choice, guided by the executive chef

day_by_day.notes: Book the extended spa session and catamaran experience well in advance as both are high-demand offerings. The catamaran excursion is weather-dependent — have a backup plan arranged with the concierge. The culinary studio evening typically begins at 18:00 and lasts approximately 2.5 hours.

day_by_day.morning: Leisure morning with a private sunrise fishing experience on a traditional Maldivian dhoni. Join the resort's fishing guide for a traditional line fishing session at dawn — a cultural and serene experience on the calm morning ocean. Any catch can be prepared by the resort's chef for a personalized meal later in the day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the resort's private sandbank — the resort's team sets up a luxury 'Robinson Crusoe' experience with sun loungers, a parasol, chilled drinks, and a grazing table of snacks. Swim, snorkel, or simply lie back and listen to the ocean. A private photo session with the resort's in-house photographer captures your honeymoon memories.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience (Second Opportunity): Take a second chance to witness the magical bioluminescent ocean, this time with the confidence of knowing what to expect. Guide the experience yourself as you've now learned the best techniques to create the glowing light trails. Followed by a late-night beachside bonfire with s'mores and stargazing.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-fishing breakfast — energy bars, fresh fruit, and thermos coffee to take on the boat
meals.lunch: Your freshly caught fish, prepared by the resort's chef in your chosen style — grilled with lemon and herbs, or as a Maldivian curry — served on the sandbank
meals.dinner: Casual beachside bonfire dinner — grilled skewers, flatbreads, dips, and tropical desserts under the stars

day_by_day.notes: The sunrise fishing experience departs at approximately 05:30 — set an early alarm. The private photographer session on the sandbank should be booked through the concierge; request a 'golden hour' shoot for the most flattering light. Confirm the second bioluminescent snorkeling experience based on plankton activity reports.

day_by_day.morning: Final full-day celebration morning — enjoy a grand in-villa breakfast feast delivered to your deck, complete with Champagne, fresh tropical fruits, pastries, eggs, and a special honeymoon cake prepared by the resort's pastry chef. Spend the morning swimming in your private plunge pool and reminiscing about the incredible week.
day_by_day.afternoon: Last afternoon water adventure — choose your favorite activity from the week for a final encore: coral garden snorkeling, kayaking the lagoon, or a leisurely paddleboard session. Alternatively, visit the resort's spa for individual relaxation treatments to prepare for the journey home. Pack and organize luggage with assistance from your personal butler.
day_by_day.evening: Maldivian Cooking Class and Beachside Dinner (Farewell Edition): Celebrate your final evening with a farewell beachside dinner — this time the resort's chef prepares a grand feast inspired by the cooking class earlier in the trip, incorporating all the flavors and dishes you've come to love. A farewell Champagne toast with the resort team marks the end of your honeymoon.

meals.breakfast: Grand in-villa Champagne breakfast feast — the resort's most extravagant morning spread
meals.lunch: Casual resort restaurant lunch — light and refreshing dishes to keep energy up for the final afternoon
meals.dinner: Farewell beachside feast — a grand spread of Maldivian and international favorites, paired with premium wines and ending with a personalized honeymoon anniversary cake

day_by_day.notes: Request a late checkout or day-use villa from the resort to allow for a relaxed final day if your departure flight is in the evening. Ask the butler to arrange a keepsake gift from the resort — many luxury Maldivian resorts provide a farewell gift such as a photo album, local crafts, or a personalized memento.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on the beach — wake early for one last magical Maldivian sunrise. Take a quiet walk along the shoreline, collect a handful of sand or a shell as a keepsake, and say a heartfelt goodbye to the Indian Ocean. Enjoy a light farewell breakfast at the resort's main restaurant with your butler.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Your personal butler oversees all luggage handling and transfer arrangements. Board the private luxury speedboat back to Malé Velana International Airport, enjoying one final view of the turquoise lagoon and white-sand beaches from the water. Arrive at the airport with ample time for your departure flight. Relax in the airport's premium lounge.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Malé — carry with you the memories of 13 extraordinary days in paradise.

meals.breakfast: Light farewell breakfast at the resort — fresh fruits, yogurt, pastries, and specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Airport premium lounge lunch or in-flight dining
meals.dinner: In-flight dining

day_by_day.notes: Confirm speedboat transfer timing with the resort concierge the evening before departure — allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for the boat transfer and airport check-in. Settle any outstanding resort charges the night before to avoid a rushed checkout. The resort's butler service will prepare a farewell gift bag with local Maldivian treats and a handwritten card.

query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026
